description: Eight bounded public-API joins checking graph, string, discrete and interval adapters with independent certificates.
state: Immutable finite fixture inputs, transformed adapter inputs, public outputs and assertion verdicts.
cost: Sum of explicitly bounded child calls and certificate checks; individual join costs and enumeration sizes are in model.md.
forward: Run the eight native public-API joins; require compatible element units, graph orientation, endpoint conventions and result certificates.
Retain distance versus path, cut value versus partition, membership versus maximality, and subset existence versus cardinality as distinct observations.
inverse: behavior_complement excludes accepted inconsistent adapter transitions.
reverse_reconstruction gives compatible implementation/adapter antecedents for an observed transcript; no unique recovery.
checks: Compiled knapsack adapter mutation must fail an assertion.
limitations: Finite domains only; shared specifications can hide common bugs.
Partial syntax projection excludes macro expansion and semantic resolution.
No allocation failure, GPU or throughput claim.
